name: Ragnarokarc Super Gandhi
original_name: ラグナロックアーク・スーパー・ガンジー
source:
Ragnarokarc Super Gandhi is the current King of the Kingdom of Zeth. Despite his status as a ruler, he's hardly around to perform his duties and the power is mostly distributed between the Four Lords of Zeth and the other political positions. He's the father of one of the Four Lords, [url=/c75983]Magic the Gandhi[/url], which makes her the princess of the country.

[spoiler]He ascended to the throne at the age of 40. He is very charismatic, and is the top magician in all of Zeth. Not only adept in magic, he is also physically very strong. However, he tends to act upon impulse and emotions, and was struggling to fight off the cunning conservatives of Zeth. Gandhi was foretold the future from the court fortune teller [url=/c56511]Arcy Julietta[/url] about the fate of the world. Upon hearing the prophecy, he left the nation under the reins of [url=/c93218]Yamada Chizuko[/url], and set off to travel the world as Punisher Mito (征伐のミト, Seibatsu no Mito), taking out villains as a vigilante and looking for the Hero to save the world. He sent [url=/c98402]Kaoru Quincy Kagura[/url] into Ice Flame, in hopes to straighten the corruption in Zeth from the rebel side.[/spoiler]

[From [url=https://alicesoft.fandom.com/wiki/Ragnarokarc_Super_Gandhi]AliceSoft Wiki[/url]]
